messages:
Alex: Quick late-watch handoff — short summary below.

oncall-bot: ALERT — embed-ingest error-rate spike detected on ingest-prod (avg 32% over last 15m). Pager assigned to @Priya.

Alex: What I did: triaged alerts, verified primary API still healthy, opened channel with infra. Blockers: regen queue backlog is growing, can't fully drain without scaling ingest. Today: hand off to day team with scaling plan.

Priya: Started root-cause analysis — IO queue on ingest nodes (i-embed-*) hit 90% iowait. Reproduced via load test. Mitigation applied: reduced parallel writers from 8 -> 4 and increased batch_size=256 in producer. Error rate -> 12%.

Priya: Command used to change config on the fly:
```
kubectl set env deployment/ingest-producer BATCH_SIZE=256 PARALLEL_WRITERS=4 -n prod
```

Sam: FYI I reverted a partial rolling update on ingest-2 yesterday that left 1 replica unschedulable — patched taints and bumped PVC resize. No longer failing scheduling.

Nina: Regen queue is at ~4.2k items, workers processing ~150/min. I spun up 4 extra workers (autoscale hit limit), so throughput jumped to ~320/min. Monitoring CPU on worker pool; if it crosses 85% we should cap concurrency.

Alex: Mitigations summary: throttled writers, increased worker count, patched node scheduling. Current status: embed errors ~10-13%, regen backlog decreasing, API latencies steady. Owner assignments:
- Priya: followup on node IO and infra request for additional io-optimized instances.
- Nina: keep an eye on regen queue and autoscaler; plan to drain to <1k by 10:30 PST.
- Sam: complete PV resize verification and postmortem notes.

Priya: Blocker for day team: need approval for 3 io-optimized instances (c5d-like) — I'll file the request and ping infra.

Alex: Day team, please pick up at 09:00 PST. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embed-ingest

oncall-bot: Incident updated — severity: minor -> acked. Next update scheduled in 30m.

Sam: quick note — rolling deploy queued for 11:00 PST (nonblocking), shall we hold until ingest is back to <5%? @Alex @Priya

Alex: Hold the deploy until we get <5% and regen backlog <1k. I will post an all-clear when satisfied. :thumbsup:

Nina: Added a watch dashboard and alert for worker CPU >85% and regen-queue >2k. Sharing graph in #monitoring: https://grafana/redwood/d/abcd123/regen

Alex: Thanks everyone. Logging off — will be available on DM for 30m then hand to day ops. Good job.
